thread:
release-bot: Kicking off staged rollout: service=re-ranker, image=redwood/re-ranker:2.0.0, target=10% global, prebake=12m, change_window_end=2025-02-14T23:15:00Z. Hooks: perf, format-check, parsing-errors.

jamie: quick confirm  are we sending the structured-json validation evals to the canary cohort?

release-bot: yes  structured-output validation is enabled for cohort. Parsers flagged: strict-json-schema and downstream-parser-integrations.

rachel: noticed an uptick in downstream parse failures for the canary group at ~15:02 UTC. Failure-rate from 0.2% -> 2.4% in the 10% sample.

devon: can you paste a few failing payloads?

rachel: ```
{"id":"abc123","result":{"items":[{"label":"foo","score":0.92}]}}
expected: top-level "meta" field present, got none -> downstream parse error
```

cs-bot: customer-impact snapshot: tenants X,Y,Z show failed parses in their integrations (auto-tagged). Link: https://cs.redwood.internal/rollouts/4321987650/impacts

jamie: hmm. This looks like a schema change in the new re-ranker. It might be intentional for richer metadata, but we didn't gate the schema invariant.

devon: propose pause further ramp, revert to 1.x format for strict-schema customers, and run a compatibility shim in front of 2.0 while we decide. Region pin unnecessary; this is a format-level compatibility problem.

jamie: agree with pause. Prefer targeted rollback for customers with strict parsing enabled rather than global rollback.

deploy-bot: Running command: `deploy-bot set-traffic --service re-ranker --percent 10 --action pause`

deploy-bot: OK  rollout paused at 10%. (cmd id: f7a1c)

rachel: I'm opening a compatibility ticket and adding a quick migration guide. Filed: https://issues.redwood.com/ISSUE-6723 (compatibility shim + opt-out flag).

cs-bot: Notifying CS leads for affected tenants. Draft message prepared, will send after we confirm mitigation path.

devon: short plan: (1) pause ramp, (2) deploy a transient compatibility shim behind edge that injects missing "meta" for strict customers, (3) run extended validation for 30m, (4) if OK unpause with 2% steps and schema telemetry. If shim fails, rollback full-service to redwood/re-ranker:1.9.x.

jamie: soft-stop vote: react :thumbsup: to stop all increases until we validate shim; :white_check_mark: to proceed with rollout.

rachel: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

jamie: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Vote tally: stop=3, continue=0. Outcome: STOP  rollout remains paused at 10%.

release-bot: Noted  rollout paused. Will append "compatibility-shim" mitigation steps to release notes and create an alert for parse-fail rate >1% for 15m.

rachel: I'll coordinate the shim deploy with infra and runtime. ETA for shim: ~25m. Will post progress in this thread.

cs-bot: once shim is in place, recommend sending a short notice to affected customers offering a rollback window if they prefer.

jamie: thanks. Next check-in in 25m or earlier if shim ready. Closing thread for decision until mitigation validated.
